_about: The copper hub described Badenhorst 2016's comparator as 'the same serum without GHK-Cu'. Reading the full PDF on 2026-09-24 for the study page showed that is not what it was: the Group 2 control was the plain serum vehicle, carrying neither GHK-Cu nor the lipid nano-carrier that delivered it. 'The same serum without X' claims the only difference was X, so it attributes the whole 55.8% gap to the peptide. The paper cannot support that — the authors describe the trial as the first to test GHK-Cu formulated into a nano-carrier. Every locale carried the same overstatement, in 12 places across six settings.
_source: Badenhorst et al., J Aging Sci 2016;4(3):166, Methods and Tables 2-3. doi:10.4172/2329-8847.1000166
_fix: Say what the control was — a plain serum base — and state the confound where there is room to.
